jobs.title: Import Department Buyer
jobs.description: Position Overview : We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate / Import Buyer to join our growing team. The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service. Supply Chain Optimization: Continuously evaluate the supply chain processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs. Risk Managemen

jobs.description: As Treasury Reporting and Analytics Manager, you will be esponsible for building and leading the Treasury Analytics and Reporting function within the Treasury Center of Excellence (CoE). The role serves as the intelligence engine of the CoE, transforming raw TMS and ERP data into actionable insights on group liquidity, FX/IR risk, debt management, and treasury performance. The role owns the Treasury Management System (TMS) reporting architecture and Power BI analytics layer, and provides decision-support to the Treasury Services Head, Treasurer, and CFO. The role also governs SLA reporting between the Treasury CoE and the Shared Treasury Operations, ensuring data integrity, forecast accuracy, and regulatory compliance across 80+ operating, pre-development, and shell entities and contribute directly to transforming energy for a better world. You will work closely with the Treasury Team to deliver results, create positive community impact, and develop your skills in a supportive, purpose-driven environment.

jobs.title: Senior IT Procurement Specialist
jobs.description: Job Title: Senior IT Procurement Specialist (Vendor Management) Location: Makati, Philippines (Hybrid – 3 days onsite and 2 days remote per week) Employment Type: Permanent Working hours: CET business hours About Us: Hubexo provides cutting-edge data, insights, and software solutions to the global construction industry. Founded in Sweden in 1936, Hubexo specializes in project information, eTendering, product information, market intelligence, and specification. With operations in more than 20 countries and a workforce of 2,500 employees, Hubexo helps its customers sell more efficiently, build sustainably, and lead the future of construction innovation. In Philippines, Hubexo operates under the legal name BCI Central. Our Values: Dream big - Embrace ambitious goals and strive to exceed expectations, every day. Thrive together - Collaborate, communicate, and celebrate success. Own it - Take ownership of your work and empower yourself to make a difference. Do the right thing - Stand firm in your values and let integrity guide your actions at every turn. About the role: We’re looking for a Senior IT Procurement Specialist to lead key sourcing and vendor management initiatives across our growing IT landscape. You’ll ensure we get the best value from our suppliers — not just in cost, but in performance, reliability, and innovation. If you’re a seasoned negotiator who knows how to balance business, technology, and supplier relationships, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Drive IT sourcing strategies and contract negotiations across hardware, software, cloud, and services. Manage vendor relationships, performance, and governance to ensure delivery excellence. Partner with IT, Finance, and Legal to align vendor spend with business goals. Analyze market trends and identify opportunities for cost optimization and innovation. Support procurement transformation and process improvement initiatives. Track and report procurement metrics to improve visibility and decision-making.
